home.step1Desc: From introductory to advanced. There's a perfect course for you, no matter your experience.
home.step2Desc: Practice with interactive exercises and quizzes that reinforce what you learn in each lesson.
home.step3Desc: Apply what you've learned with real projects and get your completion certificate.
home.ctaSub: No prior experience needed. Our courses guide you from the basics to professional levels.

about.heroSub: It's a free platform where anyone can learn to use Artificial Intelligence, regardless of your age or experience with technology.
about.audience1Desc: If you want to understand what AI is and how it can help you, this is your place.
about.audience2Desc: Learn to use AI to be more productive at work, regardless of your field.
about.audience3Desc: Courses designed with warm language, step by step, and with audio to listen to lessons.
about.audience4Desc: From the very basics to building your own AI applications.
about.feature3: Lessons with text and audio (listen to each lesson)
about.feature4: Interactive quizzes to measure your progress
about.feature5: Progress saved — continue where you left off
about.techRequired: Do I need to know anything about technology?
about.techAnswer: We start from the very basics. If you know how to write a text message, you already have everything you need to begin. Our lessons are written in warm language without jargon, with everyday analogies.
about.ctaSub: There's nothing to lose and a lot to gain. Your first course is waiting.
